name: Cristallo Resort & Spa, Cortina d'Ampezzo
insider_take: Perched in the heart of the Italian Dolomites, Cristallo Resort & Spa is a belle époque palace where Alpine grandeur meets world-class luxury — a crown jewel of Cortina d'Ampezzo since 1901.
whats_special: One of the oldest and most storied hotels in the Dolomites, Cristallo has hosted royalty, Hollywood legends, and Olympic athletes. Cortina d'Ampezzo itself hosted the 1956 Winter Olympics and is set to co-host the 2026 Winter Olympics once again, making this destination a living piece of sporting history. The resort's spa draws from the pure Alpine environment, while its position offers breathtaking panoramic views of the Dolomites — a UNESCO World Heritage Site.
pro_tip: Book a room facing the Dolomites for sunrise views that will leave you speechless — the iconic pink alpenglow on the rocky peaks, known locally as "enrosadira," is a once-in-a-lifetime sight best enjoyed from your own balcony with an espresso in hand.
dont_miss: Don't miss the legendary Cristallo Spa , one of the finest in the Alps, or a visit to the glamorous Corso Italia — Cortina's chic pedestrian promenade lined with designer boutiques and buzzing aperitivo bars. In winter, the Dolomiti Superski network connects over 1,200km of slopes right at your doorstep.
pros: Spectacular Dolomites mountain views and prime skiing location
Historic luxury resort with Belle Époque elegance and modern amenities
World-class spa facilities with comprehensive wellness treatments
Multiple dining venues including Michelin-quality cuisine
